section_summary.extract_value: This Measures section reports that body appreciation was assessed using the 10-item BAS-2; women's actual-ideal weight discrepancy was measured with the Photographic Figure Rating Scale (PFRS) (men skipped this measure); self-esteem was measured with a 9-item version of the Rosenberg Self-Esteem Scale (one item removed) with Cronbach's α = .82 (women) and .83 (men); life satisfaction was measured with the 5-item SWLS with Cronbach's α = .84. The section does not provide sample size, country, recruitment/source, survey method, BMI measurement, or any correlations between body appreciation and BMI, nor does it label any studies (e.g., 'Study 1').
section_summary.evidence_source: Body appreciation. Participants completed the 10-item BAS-2 (Tylka & Wood-Barcalow, 2015b; see Appendix for items in English and Standard Chinese). To assess women's actual-ideal weight discrepancy, we used the Photographic Figure Rating Scale (PFRS; Swami, Salem, Furnham, & Tovée, 2008). In the present work, Cronbach's α for the 9-item measure was .82 in women and .83 in men. In the present study, Cronbach's α for the SWLS was .84 in women and men, respectively.
